name: survarium::game::assign_music_emitter
evidence: Descriptive name: retains the resource in the selected music slot, stops/releases its old proxy, then calls play_music with 2000 ms and looping enabled; loading callback 0x20014bb60 selects slot 2.

name: survarium::game::play_music
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200956030; six slots; fades other playing proxies out over 2000 ms; selected slot receives duration and looping arguments; out-of-range track stops all slots.

name: survarium::loading_screen::on_music_loaded
evidence: Descriptive name: async callback installed at 0x20011b839 for mode/ui/loading_music; forwards the loaded single-sound resource to game::assign_music_emitter with slot 2.

name: vostok::sound::sound_instance_proxy::fade_out
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009d7ae0 slot 4, queues duration and proxy to 0x200623400, which converts milliseconds to samples and enters propagator state 5.

name: survarium::weapon_core_fire_state_base::on_shot_event
evidence: Qualified assertion "m_bullets_in_queue > 0" in body; animation shot event: calls weapon_core::instant_fire 0x2006d6240 with the event (time at event+0x20), decrements the queue byte +0x27c. Pixel-correct note.

name: survarium::weapon_core::instant_fire
evidence: Qualified assertion "get_user()->is_alive()"; fire matrix from 0x2006cd850 (simulated weapon/view transform) plus dispersion, then bullet manager virtual +0x58 per pellet with the shot event's time. Pixel-correct note.

name: survarium::bullet_manager::tick
evidence: Descriptive name: core tick delegate registered by 0x2002ef820; steps every bullet with 0x2003983e0(bullet, time), then applies the collected hits; a hit on a dead target still applies when its time is at or before the target's death time +0x708.

name: survarium::bullet::tick
evidence: Qualified diagnostic "survarium::bullet::tick" (unintended default case); integrates the flight from +0x58 to the step time and tests each segment with 0x200399860.

name: survarium::bullet::test_segment
evidence: Descriptive name: stores segment start/end ms at bullet+0x7c/+0x80, origin +0x70, length +0x84; ray test with mask (0x8000 << ((t0 - remote_player_delay(shooter))/tick % min(max_delay/tick+1,16))) | 0x4008, group 0x4010; crossing time t0 + (t1-t0)*dist/length.

name: survarium::game_world_core::remote_player_delay_in_ms
evidence: Qualified assertion in body; place record (core+0x17c2a0, stride 0xb8) mode +0x4b (0: base+tick, 1: base+tick*weapon factor, 2: base) and base +0x5c; result clamped to [tick, core+0x180acc max remote delay].

name: survarium::game_world_core::own_confirmation_delay
evidence: Descriptive name: the owner place's base delay +0x5c rounded up to the tick grid, at most 500 rounded to the tick; 0 on the server or with core+0x180ada. Pixel-correct note; netcode_069.md 3.1.

name: survarium::base_player::get_damage_collision_for_query
evidence: Descriptive name: needsCollision-time hook for a ray or overlap; time = crossing time of the query segment minus remote_player_delay(shooter) (one tick without a shooter), refused before spawn+tick, clamped to the newest ticked time; re-poses through 0x200307450 and caches by time and query key.

name: survarium::base_player::recompute_damage_collision_bones_for_time_ctr
evidence: Qualified assertion in body; poses the hit body at an exact ms by interpolating the local bones of two world-capture animation states (0x200306810 twice, 0x2003069e0, slerp 0x2005a9b60); interpolate_player_matrices_data is its job bundle (boost::bind, bool = parallel).

name: survarium::base_player::update_hit_history_slot
evidence: Descriptive name: from the per-tick 0x2003024c0; moves bounding body ((T/tick) % min(max_delay/tick+1,16)) to the player's root at grid time T read from the world capture's animation slot; root only, no bones.

name: survarium::base_player::insert
evidence: Qualified name and "inserting active player %d"; inserts the hit-history bounding bodies (groups 0x8000<<i | 0x40) beside the hit model.

name: survarium::explosion_damage_query
evidence: Descriptive name: explosion overlap in the thrower's delayed history slot, each player re-posed through 0x200306550 with the explosion centre as origin; callers grenade exploded state and explosive trap.

name: survarium::sensor_grenade_query
evidence: Descriptive name: sensor grenade overlap using the thrower's remote_player_delay_in_ms slot, as 0x200410100.

name: survarium::game_world::tick
evidence: Descriptive name: per frame; render time = now - min(view delay 0x2001e6600, now - tick - origin) (or now - tick while viewing a live player, 0 in a replay), then the render move 0x200236ff0 and the jobs, one of which is 0x2002374d0.

name: survarium::game_world::render_move
evidence: Descriptive name: game_world_core::move 0x2002f6610 to the grid point at or below render time - tick, then to the clock; the world is simulated to the present.

name: survarium::game_world::pose_players_for_view
evidence: Descriptive name: unconditional per-frame job; T = render time - remote_player_delay(view player of the type-8 camera controller, +0x2c0; 0 if none), then 0x200236710(T); kill-camera matrix override after it.

name: survarium::game_world::interpolate_players_at
evidence: Descriptive name: the two presentation items around T (0x200236ac0), then 0x20022f390 for every active player (+0x74c), serial or as jobs.

name: survarium::game_world::presentation_items_around
evidence: Descriptive name: ring at game_world+0xf4578 (items 0x23658 bytes, time +0x23650) at floor(T) and floor(T)+tick, created on demand.

name: survarium::base_player::interpolate_presentation
evidence: Descriptive name: root transforms at the two item times (0x20022e610 each), slerp + lerp at (T - tA)/tick into player+0x1f2e0, time +0x1f334; current transform instead when player+0x19e0 is set (a construction flag, meaning open).

name: survarium::base_player::root_transform_at
evidence: Descriptive name: the player's object root matrix at a grid time from the world capture ring (core+0x7dd8, per-player animation slot, tag +0xcd9d), virtual +0xe8 fallback, current root for the current time.

name: survarium::spectator_camera_controller::spectator_camera_controller
evidence: Descriptive name: game object type 8; reads controls/killcam (min/max_duration, victim/killer_death_duration, preview_camera ...) and parameters/has_killcam; +0x2c0 view player starts null.

name: survarium::spectator_camera_controller::set_view_player
evidence: Descriptive name: stores the intrusive player pointer at +0x2c0 (the player whose remote_player_delay_in_ms sets the presentation time).

name: survarium::spectator_camera_controller::select_view_place
evidence: Descriptive name: sets game_world+0x7b62 (view place, 0xff none) and the core owner place core+0x180ad8 (0x14 for none) to the selected place.

name: survarium::spectator_camera_controller::view_delay
evidence: Descriptive name: remote_player_delay_in_ms(game_world+0x7b62) + tick, or 0 in camera modes 2 and 3 (+0x314).

name: survarium::network_client::sample_update_latency
evidence: Descriptive name: per 0xDF; latency of the update's tick into a 257-sample ring, mean + k*spread capped at 500, falls by at most 50 a change; a change is put in the world as change_input<ping_input> at the next tick, at most every 200 ms.

name: survarium::game_world_ui::on_flash_command
evidence: Descriptive name: hud.swf command dispatch; "comment_about_user" sends a user comment (0x2001e8d60) and calls root.allow_killer_claim(false): the kill-camera report button, not a hit claim.

name: survarium::game_world_ui::send_comment_about_user
evidence: Descriptive name: u64 user, two u32 fields and the match id to the lobby connection (0x20018d870).

name: survarium::game_world_ui::process_lobby_notice
evidence: Descriptive name: notice case 6 shows st_claim_added (complaint) or st_compliment_added.

name: survarium::interpolating_camera::tick
evidence: Descriptive name: RTTI vtable 0x200970030 slot 1; Gaussian-eased interpolation of two camera matrices over wall-clock time; a camera transition, not network interpolation.
